title: House Robber
contract: Return the maximum sum of nonadjacent nonnegative house values. Choosing no house is allowed.
optimal: long previous=0,beforePrevious=0;for(int x:a){long next=Math.max(previous,beforePrevious+x);beforePrevious=previous;previous=next;emit("Skip this house or take it after skipping its neighbor","value",x,"best",previous,"previous state",beforePrevious);}return previous;
reasoning: At each house, branch into skipping one position or taking its value and skipping its neighbor.
dp[i] = max(dp[i−1], dp[i−2] + value[i]) captures every valid optimal choice.
Two previous states suffice. Compute next before updating either state, otherwise the algorithm may accidentally combine adjacent houses.
